name: Namaiki Yume-chan wa Onii to Mechakucha H Shitai!
original_name: ナマイキユメちゃんはおにぃとメチャクチャＨしたい！
source:
The protagonist returns to his hometown for the first time in several years. At the school where he is assigned to, he is reunited with his cousin Hinamori Yume.

"Onii, long time no see~!"

Just like in the past, Yume adores the protagonist, maybe even more than before. Like when he was a child and it is kind of nostalgic...... or so it should be.

"This distance is... So close!!"

Now they are a teacher and a student, and Yume also looks more mature. Nevertheless, the protagonist thinks that it would be bad for them to be together and trying desperately to keep his distance from her.

However, this act does not discourage Yume. After all, she has been waiting for a long time.

"Come on, it's fine, isn't it! Can't you be more honest and delighted~?"

"No, it's not! Just stay away! Don't cling to me!"

Thus, Yume's fierce attack on the protagonist is about to begin――

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/namaiki/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公多年来第一次回到家乡。在他所在的学校，他与表弟雏森梦重逢。

“欧尼，好久不见～！”

和以前一样，梦对主角的崇拜甚至比以前更加崇拜。就像小时候一样，有点怀旧……或者应该是这样。

“这个距离……好近！！”

现在他们既是老师又是学生，梦也显得更加成熟了。然而，主角认为他们在一起不太好，并拼命与她保持距离。

不过，这一举动并没有让Yume望而却步。毕竟，她已经等了很久了。

“来吧，没关系吧！你就不能诚实一点，高兴一点吗~？”

“不，不是！你离我远一点！别粘着我！”

于是，梦对主角的猛烈攻击即将开始——

[翻译编辑自[url=http://willplus-japan.com/tokohana/product/namaiki/#story]官方网站[/url]]
